bugs.name: Clear Filter resets an independently selected repository sort
bugs.summary: Clearing a repository filter also clears an independently selected Largest size sort.
bugs.expected: Clearing a filter should preserve an independently chosen sort.
bugs.actual: Clearing a repository filter also clears an independently selected Largest size sort.
reproSteps: Select Sort > Largest size, then Filter > Not Archived.
Observe that the sort parameter and Largest size ordering are also removed.
bugs.reason: Rejected for the pinned Gitea 1.24.7 fixture (source commit 99053ce4fa2b45f1bca5837418c0c57f793ca824): Clear Filter removes the repository-filter fields from FormData while preserving the checked sort radio. Following Largest size -> Not Archived -> Clear Filter in a fresh browser removed archived=0, retained sort=reversesize, and kept Largest size highlighted. The independently chosen sort was not reset.
